race.comment: Open race. BEYOND MYSTI (9) returns from a 20-week spell. Form in her four runs last prep was patchy, clearly the best effort a win over 1050m at this track. Races over this trip for the first time but her pattern suggests it is what she needs. Should be ready to make a positive return. DAMPEN (8) appreciated the drop in grade and got the job done over 1100m at Gawler last start. Races well here and drops 2kgs on the last run, albeit in better company. Capable of another forward display. KALMANA (4) is back after a 19-week lay-off. Has been competitive at stakes level. Good fresh performer who just needs luck from a tough draw to be in the finish. Last start Balaklava winner TOUR DE MOON (5) steps up in class but should cope.
